title: If you take these 10 Money Challenges for 2027, your life will CHANGE forever - Rahul Jain
creator: Rahul Jain
summary: Rahul Jain sets out 10 money challenges he is taking for 2027, arguing they would transform a viewer's money life by end-2027. (1) Grow net worth (assets minus liabilities) by 25% — e.g. ₹1 crore to ₹1.25 crore — starting by calculating it, since money sits scattered with relatives, in old crypto apps and in loans. (2) Explore one AI-proof business idea that could replace salary income, citing AI/layoff risk in IT and banking; examples are Airbnb hosting, franchise/laundry businesses and solar, and he targets ₹5 crore a year from a new business line. (3) Go global: move about 20% of the portfolio outside India — he moved 12% to US stocks in 2026 and plans about 8% more in 2027, keeping 40–50% in India — citing rupee depreciation toward ₹100/$, a Sensex down about 16% while global markets rose, and diversification. (4) Portfolio cleanup before March 2027: decide on loss-making and tip-based holdings, remove overlapping mutual funds, and rebalance asset allocation every six months. (5) Invest only on own research, writing five points per investment: why, exit profit, holding period, volatility tolerance and maximum loss. (6) Zero lifestyle inflation for a year — he delays upgrading his iPhone 14 and car, putting money into real estate instead. (7) Spend about ₹10 lakh on learning: technical analysis, networking and personal branding. (8) Quarterly money talks with a spouse/partner. (9) A physical financial-document folder (PAN, insurance, loans, demat/bank statements) for family access and audit trail. (10) Get a will registered, noting the Hindu Succession Act 1956, Islamic personal law and the Indian Succession Act 1925. Sponsored by Odoo Accounting. No explicit stock calls — no NSE/BSE ticker gets a BUY/SELL/HOLD with a stated ₹ price; the global allocation and business ideas are general guidance, not ticker recommendations.
